outputs.description: Band gap values and character (direct/indirect/metallic) at each compression ratio.
Transmission coefficient at the Fermi level for zigzag and armchair devices of length 24L at each compression ratio.

output_contract.notes: The band gap trend must show a direct-to-indirect transition near 5% compression and metallization near 25-30% compression. The transmission curves must exhibit chirality-dependent behaviors: zigzag devices pressure-stable at low compression and increasing above 20%; armchair devices decrease then increase. Exact values are not scored; structural trends and transition thresholds are assessed.

hidden_assets.purpose: Provide structural scoring constraints and reference tolerances for the checker
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's reported qualitative trends (Fig. 3 and Fig. 4) and description of transition thresholds.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually encoded from the paper's text: direct-to-indirect transition at ~5%, metallization at 25-30%; transmission trends. No external data file.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All checks are structural; no fabricated gold numbers are used; only threshold intervals and directional trends derived from the paper's own claims.

scoring_justification: The band gap absolute values and transmission coefficients depend strongly on the DFT code, pseudopotentials, and k-point sampling; the paper's main claim is qualitative trends (direct-to-indirect transition, metallization, chirality-dependent sensor response). Thus structural checks of gap type sequence, monotonicity, and threshold existence are the strongest feasible tier.

steps.description: Verify band gap trends: direct at 0%, indirect transition ≤10%, metallic at 30%, and monotonic gap decrease after maximum.
Verify transmission trends: zigzag flatness below 20% and sharp increase; armchair decrease to ~15% then increase.
